name: Snarlshield
body:
Price varies- Wooden Shield Bonus: +2 37 gp, Steel Shield Bonus: +2 60 gp

The snarlshield is a heavy shield that features a dozen rods protruding from its surface. When used as a weapon to bash an opponent, a snarlshield has the disarm quality.
